description: One point per patient: residual heparin at the reversal timepoint t = time to CPB + time on CPB. This is what the submitted analysis calibrated against; with it, the manuscript may claim agreement in residual amount at reversal, NOT reproduction of entire trajectories.
A grid of timepoints per patient spanning CPB onset to reversal, the window in which the nomogram is actually read. Supports a trajectory claim over that window.

A grid of timepoints per patient spanning induction (t = 0) to reversal, including the pre-bypass distribution phase. This is the only mode that supports an unqualified 'reproduces the trajectory' claim, and it is where a mono-exponential approximation of a biexponential model is worst (R2).
